verdict.rationale: The evidence documents GPU acceleration support (Metal, NVIDIA, AMD, Vulkan) but contains no first-party documentation of diagnostic output explaining why GPU initialization failed or that the runtime fell back to CPU. Community reports run the other way: one user saw raw compiler errors before a silent CPU fallback, and another could not tell why processing stayed on the CPU. With no vendor claim of clear fallback diagnostics, this is 'none' rather than 'disputed'.
